description: Net salary received where the employer has already calculated and remitted PAYE tax. Exclude from progressive tax calculation. Used purely to calculate your Total Income bracket and check if PAYE was deducted accurately.
Gross salary or fixed retainer paid by an employer who does not deduct monthly PAYE tax.
One-off or recurring project fees from local or international freelance platforms.
Monitization inflows from YouTube, ad networks, sponsored posts, or brand sponsorships.
Recurring payments for licensing software, designs, copy, stock photos, or music.
Income from selling personal, previously owned items. This is generally non-taxable.

category_name: Sales of digital or physical products
description: Income generated from the sale of physical or digital products in a business capacity.
Cost of tools used to deliver work (Adobe, GitHub, Zoom, AWS, Notion, Figma).
Monthly data plans, fiber broadband, or dedicated business phone line expenses.
Electricity bills, solar infrastructure maintenance, or fueling generators for work.
Fees paid to virtual assistants, designers, developers, or content writers helping you.
Paid campaigns on Google/Meta/LinkedIn and website domain/hosting renewals.
NTA 2025 deduction allowance calculated as 20% of your annual physical rent payment.
Contributions made personally into a registered Pension Fund Administrator (PFA).
Premium payments made to HMOs or the national health insurance framework.
Personal premium payments paid toward a valid life assurance policy.
Capital purchases used over several years (laptops, cameras, general work equipment) — NTA 2025 First Schedule Class 2, written off at 20% per year rather than deducted in full immediately.
Motor vehicles and other capital expenditure not covered elsewhere — NTA 2025 First Schedule Class 3, written off at 25% per year rather than deducted in full immediately.
Fallback category for transactions that cannot be identified.
